716730101.text: Hmm... Something feels missing from this painting. Maybe I need a bit more inspiration...

716730103.text: #Wow, look who it is! {NICKNAME}, I've heard so much about you — what an honor to finally meet you.

716730104.text: As you can see, I'm setting up a festival venue following the plans from the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

716730105.text: Umm... Are you gonna teach others to draw?

716730106.text: Ah, not quite! Instead of "teaching others to draw," I am going to "draw for others."

716730107.text: As the Lantern Rite grows bigger each year, more and more people come to join in, and many of them are tourists from faraway lands.

716730108.text: Although the Ministry of Civil Affairs offers complimentary souvenir photos, that still doesn't quite embody the spirit of Liyue.

716730109.text: That's why they sent me here — to create hand-drawn souvenirs for the visitors.

716730110.text: I noticed that the legend of the "White Horse Adeptus" is pretty well-known around Liyue Harbor, so I figured it'd make a great theme for a drawing.

716730111.text: You know how the saying goes: vibrant as dragons, spirited as steeds. So really, what's more auspicious than a "flying gallop" painting with a white horse? It's got that same bold, uplifting energy people associate with dragons and tigers.

716730112.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Got any ideas for a drawing?

716730113.text: Well, I have quite a lot...

716730114.text: Oh? Hahaha, great! Just tell me your idea, and I'll make it happen.
